published_ranges._ams: Polymaker: caution with AMS and multi-material systems (brittle and abrasive); keep bend diameter above 60 mm.
published_ranges._notes: Fiberon TDS V1.0. Store below 20% RH. Filament is brittle: keep the bend diameter above 60 mm, which matters for AMS path and buffer routing. Recommended support: PolySupport for PA12. Equilibrium water absorption is 0.37% at 70% RH. A Polymaker-specific Bambu Studio preset was not confirmed. Earlier entry: TDS: brass nozzle life about 9 h, hardened steel or ruby nozzle highly recommended; keep below 20% RH; filament is brittle (bend diameter >60 mm). Wiki requirements: all-metal hotend 260C+. Other thermal rows in the TDS text layer are garbled, only Vicat kept.
